cands.name: Dan Kiger
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 90. Appointed June 24, 2026, to succeed Sarah Stevens. Veteran State Highway Patrol trooper and police officer, and former chairman of the Surry County Republican Party.
cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he moved to North Carolina. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and we found no campaign statements on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. We found no bills he sponsored, no endorsements, and no controversies. The pages did not say how long he served as a trooper or when he chaired the Surry County Republican Party.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Veteran State Highway Patrol trooper and police officer, former Surry County Republican Party chairman, appointed to the NC House in June 2026 and then won the seat in November 2026.
qual.why: He has held a legislative seat only briefly, since June 2026, and his career is in law enforcement rather than law, policy or budget work. That puts him in the middle band, with a small credit for the legislative service and party leadership.

cands.name: Ken Badgett
cands.bio: Ken Badgett is a Democrat who ran for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 90 in 2024 and 2026. He lost both general elections to Republican incumbents. The sources I could read give no occupation or offices held.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed by the voter guide "Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy" (a Sway voting group run by Tevin (Momala) Davis) in the 2026 race.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Ken Badgett was born or raised, when he moved to North Carolina, or what his job or career has been. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026, and we found no campaign website, questionnaire or interview stating his positions on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We also found no record of actions he has taken on any of these issues, and no news coverage of controversies or foreign ties.
